name: FormSlot savings calculator
description: A calculator for what you save by using the free Form apps instead of the paid tools they replace, with an optional suggestion to support FormAI.

intro.label: Intro
intro.default: Pick the paid tools you use now. The free Form app that replaces each one adds up here, at US list prices checked 2026-11-09.

Yearly is the monthly price times 12, so a plan that publishes its own yearly price can differ by a few cents. Photoshop with Lightroom Classic counts as one Photography plan. Four or more Adobe single apps (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Lightroom Classic) use Creative Cloud Pro when it is cheaper. Framer and Webflow are priced per site, and one site each is counted. Apple Photos, Keynote, Google Docs, Sheets and Slides, Affinity and Adobe Bridge are free, so they count 0 and are not listed. The support page takes one time gifts in whole US dollars.

params.name: per
params.value: ePs + eLr + eIl + eId + eAe + eAc + eSu + eZb + eM3 + eNo + eCc + eMi + eFr + eWf + eCap

params.name: n
params.value: sPs + sLr + sIl + sId + sAe + sAc + sMe + sSu + sZb + sM3 + sNo + sCc + sMi + sPu + sFr + sWf + sCl

params.name: phHead
params.value: if(sPs && sLr, "Photography plan 20GB covers Photoshop and Lightroom Classic, $14.99 a month", "Single App, annual billed monthly, $22.99 a month")

params.name: lrHead
params.value: if(sPs && sLr, "In the Photography plan with Photoshop, counted once", "Photography plan 20GB, $14.99 a month")

params.name: mx
params.value: max(ePs, eLr, eIl, eId, eAe, eAc, eSu, eZb, eM3, eNo, eCc, eMi, eFr, eWf)

params.name: errP
params.value: if(people < 1, "at least 1", if(people > 50, "50 people is the top", if(people != floor(people), "whole numbers only", "")))

params.name: errY
params.value: if(years < 1, "at least 1", if(years > 5, "5 years is the top", if(years != floor(years), "whole numbers only", "")))
